headline: 7 saves from Beiranvand help Iran battle to 0-0 draw with Belgium
summary: Iran holds on for a scoreless tie in Group G, remaining alive in the World Cup competition despite Belgium's pressure.
details: Iran secured a 0-0 draw against Belgium in their second Group G match on Sunday afternoon in Inglewood, California.
Goalkeeper Alireza Beiranvand was the star of the match, making seven crucial saves to keep a clean sheet for the second time in his World Cup career.
Belgium played with 10 men for the final 30 minutes after Nathan Ngoy received a red card in the 66th minute for a foul on an Iranian attacker.
Despite the man advantage, Iran struggled with possession, holding only 32% of the ball and being outshot 7-3 in shots on target.
Belgium remained dangerous even with one less player, nearly scoring in the 86th minute before Beiranvand made another diving stop.
Both teams now have two points from two matches, meaning a win in their final group game on June 26 could see them advance.
Iran will face Egypt in Seattle, while Belgium will take on New Zealand in Vancouver for the final matchday of Group G.
caption:
7 saves and a man advantage! Iran holds Belgium to a 0-0 draw to stay alive in the World Cup.

Iran secured a 0-0 draw against Belgium in their second Group G match on Sunday afternoon in Inglewood, California.

Goalkeeper Alireza Beiranvand was the star of the match, making seven crucial saves to keep a clean sheet for the second time in his World Cup career.

Belgium played with 10 men for the final 30 minutes after Nathan Ngoy received a red card in the 66th minute for a foul on an Iranian attacker.

Despite the man advantage, Iran struggled with possession, holding only 32% of the ball and being outshot 7-3 in shots on target.

Belgium remained dangerous even with one less player, nearly scoring in the 86th minute before Beiranvand made another diving stop.

Both teams now have two points from two matches, meaning a win in their final group game on June 26 could see them advance.

Iran will face Egypt in Seattle, while Belgium will take on New Zealand in Vancouver for the final matchday of Group G.

headline: MP's son Khairul expelled from Jubo Dal and taken into DB custody
summary: The son of Narayanganj MP Mannan, Khairul, has been removed from the party wing and is currently in police custody.
details: Khairul, the son of Narayanganj MP Mannan, has been expelled from the Jubo Dal party wing.
He is currently in the custody of the Detective Branch (DB) of the police.
The expulsion comes amid his ongoing detention by law enforcement agencies.
caption:
An MP's son expelled and detained. Khairul is now in DB custody.

Khairul, the son of Narayanganj MP Mannan, has been expelled from the Jubo Dal party wing.

He is currently in the custody of the Detective Branch (DB) of the police.

The expulsion comes amid his ongoing detention by law enforcement agencies.
